method.pair_eligibility: same complete CONFIG identity, sequence+1, CRC/identity/wire valid; both points valid/fresh/expected/acquired and error-free
method.all_board_screen: all64 comparable points must each change in the same direction by at least18mV
method.rounding: none before differencing; original integer microvolts
method.distribution: observed min/max, linearly interpolated P05/P95, population stddev; not accuracy/CI

timing.cell_sample_interval: NOT_REPORTED; frame timestamps/durations do not establish each cell's sampling time

rails.source_limit: frame ref=AVDD_AVSS is the ADC reference, not an external-calibration-source field; fixed external provenance is query evidence

precision_aggregate.per_frame_precision_state: only explicit ADSHEALTH precisionFrame for its logged seq; ADS50 is aggregate, not a complete per-frame map

limits: Passive10k/33pF plus60 floating cells, no controlled stable voltage source.
Original E1 complete raw files absent; this is a later finite-condition observation, not an exact A/B recreation.
No simultaneous oscilloscope/analogue-state verification; numeric common changes cannot uniquely identify a physical cause.
A frame timestamp is not a per-cell sample timestamp; host receipt is not over-air or USB wire time.
